newsitem.title: USA: Isuzu says NHTSA clears the Isuzu Trooper.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu says NHTSA clears the Isuzu Trooper.

text.p: Isuzu Motors America Inc and American Isuzu Motors Inc said Thursday that they have been told by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) of its decision to deny a request by Consumer Reports Magazine for an investigation into the safety of the Isuzu Trooper sport utility vehicle.
Late last year the magazine had requested the investigation, saying the vehicle was prone to be unstable in extreme maneuvering conditions.

"NHTSA made this decision because its own testing of the Trooper failed to show the same results alleged by the magazine and, more importantly, because it again judged the Consumer Reports test to be unscientific," said a news release issued by Isuzu.
The company said it will hold a news conference in Los Angeles Friday to discuss the magazine's allegations.
